content: Pekuru kemɨtiwarutahekɨatɨa memɨyutixexeɨriwa Kerutsaremetsie
Hikɨ nɨ'ariekate meta 'iwamarixi Kureyatsie memu'uwakai mekateniutamarieni kename mɨkɨ memɨkahuriyutsixi Kakaɨyari niukieya me'utanaki'eriekai.
Kepauka Pekuru Kerutsaremetsie meutiyunixɨ, mɨkɨ xitekiya 'inɨariyaritsie miemekɨ mekaniniukimakaitɨni
mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ: —¿Titayari 'ekɨ teɨteri xitekiya 'inɨariyari memɨkahexeiya wahetsɨa petinua meta wahamatɨa perekwakai?
Pekuru katiniwarutixatɨatɨyani xexuime kemɨreyɨkai hepaɨtsita:

—Ne kiekari Kupe mɨrakutewatsie nehekaitɨ. Nekaneyunenewiekaitɨni, heinɨtsi hepaɨ 'anekame nekanexeiya, taheima 'akamieme tetsitana naukakɨa hawiwietɨkaime tsawana 'amɨyewa hepaɨ tiyuxexeiyame, nemanukateitsie 'aurie kaniuteni.
Nekaniwaxeiyakaitɨni mana memɨte'atitekai, nauka 'ɨkateyari memexeiya kwiepa miemete, yeutari, kuterixi meta memɨte'awɨwawe nekaniwaruxeiya.
Hikɨ xeime nekaniu'enieni mɨpaɨ netikɨhɨaweme: “Pekuru kenanukukexi, keniwarukwika keniwarutikwa'i”.
Ne mɨpaɨ nekaniutayɨni: “Ti'aitame pɨkatixaɨ, tita 'axamɨti'anene mɨkati'itiyatɨka hatsuaku neteta pɨkareutahawe”.
Hutarieka mɨpaɨ kanetiniuta'eiya kemɨ'ane taheima mutaniukakai: “Tita Kakaɨyari mɨti'itie 'ekɨ 'axati'anenekame pepɨkati'erieka”.
Haikakɨa mɨpaɨ katiniuyɨni, hikɨta naitɨ taheima kananutihanieni.
»Hikɨ 'ana yuhaikatɨ teɨteri nekie nemɨwayekateitsie mekaniu'axɨani, nehetsɨa memeyenɨ'arie Tsetsareyatsie meheyekɨneka.
'Iyari mɨpaɨ pɨnetiutahɨawixɨ: “Wahamatɨa kenemie tixaɨtɨkɨ pekati'a'iyaritɨatɨ”. Meta ta'iwama 'ataxewitɨ nehamatɨa mekanekɨne, mɨkɨ tewi kiita tekaneutahaxɨani.
Mɨkɨ katatiniutahekɨatɨani niuki tuayame kemɨtiuxei yukiita mɨpaɨ tikɨhɨaweme: “Xeime keneutanɨ'a Kupe paitɨ Tsimuni Pekuru mɨtitewa mɨwitɨkiemiekɨ.
Mɨkɨ niuki pɨmatsitaxatɨani kɨmana 'ekɨ meta 'akie kiekatari yunaitɨ xemɨtawikweitsitɨarienikɨ”.
»Kepauka netiutsutɨaku netikuxatatɨ, 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata wahetsie pɨtiuwiyaxɨ tahepaɨ tsutɨapai tahetsie mɨtiuwiyaxɨ hepaɨ.
Hikɨ ne nepaye'eri Ti'aitame niukieya kemainekai: “Wani hakɨ pɨtiuka'ɨyakai, xeme pɨta 'Iyari Mɨtiyupatakɨ xepɨka'ɨyarieni”.
'Ayumieme, xɨka Kakaɨyari wayetuirieni mɨkɨ 'imikieri yaxeikɨa tame kemɨtatiupitɨa Ti'aitame Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu hetsie yuri tete'uta'erieku, ¿Ne ketsɨ netiyɨwekai Kakaɨyari nema'imaiyanikɨ?

Hikɨ 'ikɨ me'u'enieka, kayuwatɨ mekaniutamare, 'aixɨa mekaniutiyuanekaitɨni Kakaɨyari hepaɨtsita mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ: —Mɨkɨta Kakaɨyari katiniwarupitɨani memɨkahuriyutsixi memɨtehayewanikɨ kememɨteyuriekai matsi tukari memexeiyanikɨ.
'Anutiyukiyatsie memuyutixexeɨriwa
Hikɨ mɨkɨ memeutaweiyariexɨakai 'umierieku 'Etsitewani, Penitsiyatsie, Tsipɨretsie meta 'Anutiyukiyatsie mekaneta'axɨani, hipame niuki mepɨkawakuxaxatɨwakai, huriyutsixi xeikɨa.
Hipatɨ mɨkɨ Tsipɨre meta Tsirene mekanikiekataritɨkaitɨni, mɨkɨ 'Anutiyukiya me'u'axɨaka niuki 'aixɨa manuyɨne mekaniwakuxaxatɨwakaitɨni kɨriyekutsixi Ti'aitame Ketsutsi hepaɨtsita.
Mɨkɨ Ti'aitame tɨrɨkariyaya kaniwaparewiekaitɨni, yuwaɨkawatɨ yuri mekateniuta'erieni, Ti'aitame hetsie mekateniuwiya.
Hikɨ wahepaɨtsita mepu'enana mɨkɨ Kerutsaremetsie memɨyutixexeɨriwakai, Werunawe 'Anutiyukiya paitɨ mekanenɨ'ani.
Nuaka, nieretɨ Kakaɨyari 'aixɨa kemɨtiuka'iyarikai, kaniyutemawiekaitɨni. Yunaime kaniwatuikakaitɨni Ti'aitame hetsie memɨtewiyanikɨ, wa'iyari ya'anekaku.
Mɨkɨ tewi 'aixɨa pɨtiyurienekai, 'Iyari Mɨtiyupatakɨ pɨhɨnekai, meta yuri pɨti'eriekai. Yumɨiretɨ teɨteri Ti'aitame hetsie mekateniuwiya.
Manata Werunawe Tarutsu paitɨ kaneyani Tsauru kuwaunetɨ, kepauka mitaxei 'Anutiyukiya paitɨ kaneiwitɨni.
Mana xeiwiyari mepuyuri memɨyutixexeɨriwakai wahamatɨa meyukuxexeɨriwatɨ. Yumɨireme mekateniwa'ɨkitɨakaitɨni, 'Anutiyukiyatsie teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete “Kɨritsitiyanutsixi” mepɨte'utaterɨwarie matɨari.
Hikɨ 'ana Kakaɨyari niukametemama kerutsaremetari 'Anutiyukiya paitɨ mekanakanexɨani.

Mɨkɨ xewitɨ 'anukukeka 'Akawu mɨtitewakai katiniutahekɨata, 'Iyari mɨpaɨ titahekɨatɨaku kename hakaxa 'ayanikekai waɨkawa naitsarie teɨteri mematitekaitsie, mɨpaɨ pɨtiuyɨ kepauka Kɨrauriyu mɨti'aitametɨkai mɨkɨ kwieyaritsie.
Yuxexuitɨ teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete kememɨteheixeiyakai, mekaniyuwaɨriyakaitɨni tixaɨtɨ memɨte'anunɨ'anikɨ memɨwaparewienikɨ yu'iwama Kureyatsie memɨtamakai.
Mɨpaɨtsɨ mepɨte'uyuri, 'imikieri mawariyari mepukuxeɨri, Werunawe meta Tsauru mekaniwaru'ɨitɨani 'ukirawetsixi memɨwareyetuirienikɨ.
